brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

requirements.evidence: Build contains exactly one piece: piece:0,0,0;full at 0,0,0 - no other pieces placed.

requirements.requirement: Nothing else added beside or on top of it
requirements.evidence: Build has only the single base; no adjacent cells (q±1, r±1) and no level 1 piece; counts {piece:1}

Configurator offers zero drawer sockets on a full hex base (find_sockets drawer = 0). Only half bases offer 1 drawer (tested half-n -> s slot) and notch/bay drawers require adjacent bases beside the drawer position. Five drawers in a single isolated base is not offerable; cannot be placed without adding beside/on-top structure which would violate requirement 2.

finish.summary: Build retains single full hex base with nothing beside/on top per brief. Five drawers is impossible: full bases have no drawer sockets; half bases allow only one; notch/bay drawers require neighboring bases. Check_build shows mesh clear, only info about open cap faces.
